After losing their first two encounters against the Tridents, the Kingsmen turned the tables by demolishing them in the biggest game of their campaign, marching on to Qualifier 2. The Barbados Tridents crash out of the tournament in front of their home supporters. Anderson bowls it quick and wide down the leg side; Ayub attempts to sweep it away but fails to connect. Wide is signaled by the on-field umpire.

Daniel Sams to Maaz Sadaqat WICKET 0 runs
<b>Finally, Maaz Sadaqat power hitting display comes to an end!</b> Slower ball to the rescue for Sams. Pitched up front off-cutter ball, shimmies down the track to send it downtown again, miscues the stroke high in the air and Sams gobbles it up on his follow-through. Daniel Sams jogs over to the dismissed batter, shakes his hand and gives him a few pats on the helmet. A world-class innings from a superstar in the making, finally providing some much-needed positivity for Pakistan cricket.

11.3 1
Daniel Sams to Maaz Sadaqat 1 run
His first-ever T20 century for the young batter from Peshawar! What a stage and moment to bring up the milestone off just 44 deliveries, playing a top-class knock that completely took the Tridents out of the contest. The dressing room is fired up with a massive round of applause. A wide, full length delivery, dabbed toward short third man before taking off for a quick single. Zachary Carter, known as one of the weakest links in the field for the Tridents, misfields as usual, allowing the batters to rotate the strike. Sadaqat sprints in celebration and leaps into the air. What an unforgettable moment!

Kevlon Anderson to Saim Ayub 1 run
After losing their first two encounters against the Tridents, the Kingsmen turned the tables by demolishing them in the biggest game of their campaign, marching on to Qualifier 2. The Barbados Tridents crash out of the tournament in front of their home supporters. Anderson bowls it quick and wide down the leg side; Ayub attempts to sweep it away but fails to connect. Wide is signaled by the on-field umpire.

Daniel Sams to Maaz Sadaqat WICKET 0 runs
<b>Finally, Maaz Sadaqat power hitting display comes to an end!</b> Slower ball to the rescue for Sams. Pitched up front off-cutter ball, shimmies down the track to send it downtown again, miscues the stroke high in the air and Sams gobbles it up on his follow-through. Daniel Sams jogs over to the dismissed batter, shakes his hand and gives him a few pats on the helmet. A world-class innings from a superstar in the making, finally providing some much-needed positivity for Pakistan cricket.

11.3 1
Daniel Sams to Maaz Sadaqat 1 run
His first-ever T20 century for the young batter from Peshawar! What a stage and moment to bring up the milestone off just 44 deliveries, playing a top-class knock that completely took the Tridents out of the contest. The dressing room is fired up with a massive round of applause. A wide, full length delivery, dabbed toward short third man before taking off for a quick single. Zachary Carter, known as one of the weakest links in the field for the Tridents, misfields as usual, allowing the batters to rotate the strike. Sadaqat sprints in celebration and leaps into the air. What an unforgettable moment!
